title: August and the Garden
author: Oscar Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
